recordType.description: Identifies the record as a header record.

fileName.description: Unique file name for each type of file, such as Person, Employment, or Relationship.

fileType.description: Identifies the file type. The file type must match the extension of the file itself.

sourceId.description: Unique identifier associated with the vendor sending the file.

createDate.description: Date of file creation by the vendor.

createTimestamp.description: Timestamp of file creation by the vendor.

periodBeginDate.description: Marks the beginning of the data period. Typically defaults to the first day of the previous month unless otherwise defined by the client.

periodEndDate.description: Marks the ending of the data period. Typically defaults to the last day of the previous month unless otherwise defined by the client.

recordCount.description: Number of employment records in the file.

uniqueId.description: Primary participant identifier. This could be the SSN or Employee ID as determined by the project team.

sourceAssignmentId.description: Assignment key that identifies the job when an employee has the same employee ID across multiple jobs under the same employer.

employeeId.description: Unique employee identifier. This is the internal payroll employee number.

employerCode.description: Unique employer code generated by BenefitsIQ and used by the employer when providing these files.

lastName.description: Employee's last name used to help identify the employee record. This field does not get loaded.

firstName.description: Employee's first name used to help identify the employee record. This field does not get loaded.

effectiveDate.description: Represents the as-of date for an employment action or change. Used for new hires, re-hires, terminations, and applicable changes in contribution group or position status.

updateType.description: Identifies the type of employment update being reported.

status.description: Employment status. If not provided, the value may be derived based on configured mappings.

action.description: Represents the HR action associated with the employment record.

reason.description: Represents the HR reason associated with the reported action.

jobType.description: Identifies the employee's job or employment type.

department.description: Department associated with the employee's position.

division.description: Division associated with the employee's position.

businessUnit.description: Business unit associated with the employee's position.

region.description: Region associated with the employee's position or work location.

exempt.description: Indicates the employee's exempt status from applicable wage-and-hour requirements.

unionAffiliation.description: Indicates whether the employee is part of a collective bargaining unit.

unionCode.description: Identifies the union when union affiliation applies.

positionNumber.description: Identifies the employee's position code or position number.

jobClassification.description: Identifies the occupational classification associated with the employee's position.

payPlan.description: Identifies the pay schedule governing the employee's compensation structure.

grade.description: Identifies the employee's grade within the applicable pay plan.

payLevel.description: Identifies the employee's specific salary level or step within the applicable pay plan.

salaryRateCode.description: Identifies the compensation basis used to calculate the employee's pay.

dutyStationStateCode.description: Identifies the state associated with the employee's official duty station.

dutyStationCountyCode.description: Identifies the county associated with the employee's official duty station.

dutyStationCityCode.description: Identifies the city or locality associated with the employee's official duty station.

specialEmployeeCode.description: Identifies employees with special or enhanced employment or retirement provisions.

expatriate.description: Indicates whether the employee is temporarily working in a country other than their home country under an employer-managed arrangement.

workAuthorizationStatus.description: Indicates the employee's work authorization status.

officer.description: Indicates whether the employee is recognized as an officer of the legal entity.

ficaCode.description: Identifies the Social Security and Medicare tax coverage applicable to the employee.

tenure.description: Classifies the permanence of the employee's appointment.

supervisorEmail.description: Email address of the employee's supervisor.

participatingGroupCode.description: Code identifying the employee's participating group.

annuitantClaimNumber.description: Annuitant claim number associated with the employee.

pshbEligibilityStatus.description: Identifies the employee's PSHB eligibility status.

pshbEligibilityEffectiveDate.description: Effective date of the employee's PSHB eligibility status.

payrollOfficeId.description: Identifies the payroll office associated with the employee.

pshbRateScheduleCode.description: Identifies the PSHB rate schedule applicable to the employee.

pshbRateCategoryCode.description: Identifies the PSHB rate category applicable to the employee.

terminationNoaCode.description: Identifies the notice or action code associated with employee termination.

rsActionCode.description: Identifies the retirement-system action code associated with the employment record.

owcpRollType.description: Identifies the OWCP roll type associated with the employee.

owcpTerminationIndicator.description: Indicates whether an OWCP termination event applies.

owcpTransferInIndicator.description: Indicates whether an OWCP transfer-in event applies.

transferInEffectiveDate.description: Effective date of the transfer-in event.

owcpReinstatementIndicator.description: Indicates whether an OWCP reinstatement event applies.

reinstatementDate.description: Effective date of the employee's reinstatement.

reEmployedAnnuitantIndicator.description: Indicates whether the employee is a re-employed annuitant.

preTaxHealthBenefitIndicator.description: Indicates whether the employee has the pre-tax health benefit designation.
